​Some worlds are not just watched they are stepped back into. See how the Accenture Song VFX team helped to bring Avatar: The Last Airbender Season 2 to life; from the vast landscapes of the Earth Kingdom to the mystery of the Spirit World and the energy of bending in motion. This breakdown offers a closer look at one of those moments: the giant owl spirit, Wan Shi Tong, as he comes apart and rebuilds from bare bones to feathers. Because the magic works best when you never see the wires. ✨ See the work, from first pixel to final frame: https://accntu.re/4bN1mc2 [Video Description: A VFX breakdown from, Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 2 moves from a mountain scene into a dark library, revealing how a giant owl-like creature develops from skeletal and muscle models into its final rendered form. Ends with Accenture Song #VFX.]
